question: Must the ritual be performed strictly according to the declared non-dual principle?
premises: Non-duality has been declared as the guiding principle.
The practice must be done as declared.
Doing it otherwise is explicitly prohibited.
inference: The ritual must be performed in accordance with the declared non-duality and not otherwise.
plain_english: Non-duality must indeed be practiced just as it has been declared; it must not be done otherwise.
